Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(rgrass)

# connect to GRASS
NinaR::grassConnect(location = "ETRS_32N", mapset = "p_Restaurerbar_Akershus")
```

Set up GRASS environment

```{r echo=FALSE}
execGRASS("g.region", vector = "akershus_vect", flags = "p", res = "10")
execGRASS("g.remove", type = "raster", name = "MASK", flags = "f")
execGRASS("r.mask", vector = "akershus_vect")
```
